exams.name: ITIL 4 Foundation
exams.blurb: Entry-level IT service management certification covering the ITIL 4 service value system, guiding principles, four dimensions and key practices.

exams.name: ITIL 4 Leader: Digital and IT Strategy
exams.blurb: Strategic Leader module covering digital strategy, disruption response, operating model design and aligning IT strategy with business direction.

exams.name: ITIL 4 Managing Professional
exams.blurb: Designation awarded after completing the CDS, DSV, HVIT and DPI modules, aimed at practitioners running IT-enabled products and services.

exams.name: ITIL 4 Master
exams.blurb: Highest ITIL designation, awarded through submission and defence of real-world evidence rather than a written exam, after Managing Professional.

exams.name: ITIL 4 Specialist: Collaborate, Assure and Improve
exams.blurb: ITIL 4 Practice Manager module covering relationship, supplier, service level, continual improvement and information security management practices.

exams.name: ITIL 4 Specialist: Create, Deliver and Support
exams.blurb: Managing Professional module covering the design, development and operation of service value streams, team culture, tooling and workflow management.

exams.name: ITIL 4 Specialist: Drive Stakeholder Value
exams.blurb: Managing Professional module on customer journeys, service relationships, demand shaping, service level management and stakeholder engagement.

exams.name: ITIL 4 Specialist: High-velocity IT
exams.blurb: Managing Professional module on digital product delivery, lean and agile ways of working, automation and resilient high-velocity operating models.

exams.name: ITIL 4 Specialist: Monitor, Support and Fulfil
exams.blurb: ITIL 4 Practice Manager module bundling the incident, problem, service desk, service request and monitoring and event management practices.

exams.name: ITIL 4 Specialist: Plan, Implement and Control
exams.blurb: ITIL 4 Practice Manager module covering change enablement, release, deployment, IT asset, service configuration and deployment management practices.

exams.name: ITIL 4 Strategic Leader
exams.blurb: Designation awarded after completing Direct, Plan and Improve plus Digital and IT Strategy, aimed at leaders shaping digital service strategy.

exams.name: ITIL 4 Strategist: Direct, Plan and Improve
exams.blurb: Universal ITIL 4 module required for both Managing Professional and Strategic Leader, covering governance, planning, measurement and improvement.

exams.name: Juniper Networks Certified Associate - Cloud
exams.blurb: Associate Juniper certification covering cloud architectures, virtualisation, software-defined networking, containers and Juniper cloud products.

exams.name: Juniper Networks Certified Associate - DevOps
exams.blurb: Associate Juniper certification covering network automation with Python, PyEZ, REST APIs, Ansible and Junos automation frameworks.

exams.name: Juniper Networks Certified Associate - Junos
exams.blurb: Entry-level Juniper certification covering the Junos operating system, configuration basics, routing fundamentals and device monitoring.

exams.name: Juniper Networks Certified Associate - Security
exams.blurb: Associate Juniper security certification covering SRX Series firewall basics, security zones, policies, NAT and unified threat management.

exams.name: Juniper Networks Certified Expert - Enterprise Routing and Switching
exams.blurb: Expert-level Juniper lab exam requiring candidates to build and troubleshoot a complex enterprise network within a timed hands-on environment.

exams.name: Juniper Networks Certified Professional - Enterprise Routing and Switching
exams.blurb: Professional-level Juniper exam covering advanced routing policy, BGP scaling, multicast, EVPN-VXLAN and enterprise network troubleshooting.

exams.name: Juniper Networks Certified Specialist - Enterprise Routing and Switching
exams.blurb: Specialist-level Juniper exam covering OSPF, IS-IS, BGP, spanning tree, layer two security and enterprise switching on Junos devices.

exams.name: Juniper Networks Certified Specialist - Security
exams.blurb: Specialist Juniper security exam covering advanced SRX policy, IPsec VPNs, application security, Juniper ATP and security troubleshooting.

exams.name: Juniper Networks Certified Specialist - Service Provider Routing and Switching
exams.blurb: Specialist Juniper exam for carrier networks covering IS-IS, OSPF, BGP, MPLS fundamentals and service provider switching on Junos platforms.

exams.name: Certified Wireless Analysis Professional
exams.blurb: CWNP certification on protocol analysis, spectrum analysis, frame exchanges and advanced troubleshooting of 802.11 wireless networks.

exams.name: Certified Wireless Design Professional
exams.blurb: CWNP certification on WLAN design covering requirements gathering, predictive and validation surveys, capacity planning and vertical market design.

exams.name: Certified Wireless IoT Solutions Administrator
exams.blurb: CWNP certification covering wireless internet of things technologies beyond Wi-Fi, including Bluetooth, LoRaWAN, cellular and industrial protocols.

exams.name: Certified Wireless Network Administrator
exams.blurb: Vendor-neutral wireless networking certification covering radio frequency fundamentals, 802.11 standards, site surveys, security and troubleshooting.

exams.name: Certified Wireless Network Expert
exams.blurb: Top CWNP credential awarded by application review after earning CWNA, CWSP, CWDP and CWAP plus documented enterprise wireless experience.

exams.name: Certified Wireless Security Professional
exams.blurb: Vendor-neutral certification on wireless security covering 802.1X, EAP methods, WPA3, intrusion prevention and secure WLAN design and auditing.

exams.name: Certified Wireless Technician
exams.blurb: Entry-level CWNP certification for wireless installers covering access point mounting, configuration, basic troubleshooting and site documentation.

exams.name: BICSI Installer 1
exams.blurb: Entry-level BICSI credential for structured cabling installers covering safety, hand tools, cable pulling, termination and basic testing procedures.

exams.name: BICSI Installer 2
exams.blurb: BICSI credential offered in copper and optical fibre tracks, covering advanced installation, termination, testing and cabling standards compliance.

exams.name: BICSI Technician
exams.blurb: BICSI credential for lead installers covering project planning, team supervision, advanced troubleshooting and retrofitting cabling infrastructure.

exams.name: Data Center Design Consultant
exams.blurb: BICSI credential for data centre designers covering site selection, power, cooling, cabling topology, redundancy tiers and facility standards.

exams.name: Registered Communications Distribution Designer
exams.blurb: Senior BICSI design credential covering telecommunications distribution design, pathways, spaces, grounding, codes and standards for buildings.

exams.name: Palo Alto Networks Certified Cybersecurity Entry-level Technician
exams.blurb: Entry-level Palo Alto certification covering cybersecurity fundamentals, network security concepts, cloud security and security operations basics.

exams.name: Palo Alto Networks Certified Detection and Remediation Analyst
exams.blurb: Certification for SOC analysts using Cortex XDR, covering threat detection, investigation, endpoint protection policy and incident remediation.

exams.name: Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator
exams.blurb: Administrator certification on configuring and managing Palo Alto next-generation firewalls including security policy, App-ID, User-ID and logging.

exams.name: Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer
exams.blurb: Engineer-level certification on designing, deploying and troubleshooting Palo Alto firewall estates, Panorama, high availability and advanced features.

exams.name: Palo Alto Networks Certified Software Firewall Engineer
exams.blurb: Certification on deploying VM-Series, CN-Series and cloud next-generation firewalls across public cloud, virtualised and Kubernetes environments.
